summary: CMB.TECH NV filed a Form 6-K announcing the publication of its annual report under Belgian law, submission of Form 20-F for FY2025, and the convening of its Annual General Meeting and Special General Meeting on May 21, 2026. The filing includes standard procedural details such as record date, freeze period for share transfers, and availability of meeting documents. No special-situation event—no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change—is disclosed. The filing is a routine periodic report and meeting notice.
